note.fact: A smooth periodic datum has finite H^m and dot H^m norms for every positive integer m. A periodic KdV path belonging to C([0,T];H^m) for every such m is smooth in space and time (with one-sided time derivatives at the endpoints). The smooth-path twist v=S_(-t)u is differentiable and satisfies v'=(1/2)B_t(v,v).

grounds.reason: L3 supplies smooth datum, and E001 is applied at every positive-integer regularity; uniqueness makes these the same path.
Supplies continuity at each regularity and compatibility of source flows.
The Fourier multiplier of S_t has derivative ik^3 times that multiplier, corresponding to -partial_x^3.
B_t is defined on smooth inputs as S_(-t)partial_x[(S_t f)(S_t g)].

note.justification: Repeated integration by parts gives arbitrarily fast Fourier decay for smooth data. For a path in all H^m, Cauchy-Schwarz with m>j+1/2 gives absolute, uniformly convergent Fourier series for each jth spatial derivative; continuity in H^m gives joint continuity. Products are continuous in each integer H^m for m>=1: by the Leibniz rule, in every derivative term up to order m, one factor has derivative order at most m-1 and is bounded by its H^1 norm via the same Fourier Cauchy-Schwarz estimate, while the other is in L^2. The distributional equation consequently has a continuous right side in any desired H^r, using continuity of u in a sufficiently higher H^m. Integrating it in H^r gives a continuously differentiable time path there. Repeating this argument with the differentiated polynomial equation yields every time derivative and joint smoothness. Finally differentiating S_(-t) on these smooth paths gives v'=S_(-t)(u_t+u_xxx)=S_(-t)partial_x(u^2)/2=B_t(v,v)/2, exactly the identity in S002.

arguments.proof:
intro s f g h
have he : (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2) = (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖g k‖^2) := by funext k; rw [h k]
constructor
· unfold KdVPlan.MemH; rw [he]
· unfold KdVPlan.hn; rw [he]

note.fact: For every real s, spatial reflection with sign Jf(x)=-f(-x) is an isometric involution on the mean-zero homogeneous and inhomogeneous Fourier Sobolev spaces, preserving reality. The multipliers S_t and the source untwisting multipliers exp(-it k^3) are strongly continuous isometries on these spaces. Thus a continuous twisted H^s path untwists to a continuous physical H^s path; J and these multipliers preserve convergence used in smooth approximation.

grounds.reason: The Fourier normalization specifies the reflection coefficient identity.
H^s is defined by the weighted square sum and reality by coefficient conjugacy.
The homogeneous norms are on the mean-zero subspace.
The Airy multiplier has unit modulus.
E001 supplies continuity of the source twisted path at the applicable regularity.

note.justification: Change variables x to -x modulo 2pi to obtain (Jf)^hat(k)=-f^hat(-k), first for polynomials and then by completion. The weights are even, which proves the isometry and real/mean-zero assertions. Multiplier continuity follows by approximating a fixed vector by a finite Fourier sum: its finite part is continuous in t and the remaining weighted square norm stays uniformly small by isometry. For a varying path split the difference into the path difference and the multiplier difference on a fixed vector. Apply these bounded maps to each approximating path; the same split proves continuity and preserves convergence.

note.fact: For U in C([0,T];L^2(Torus)), the distributional source equation U_t=UU_x+U_xxx, with UU_x=(1/2)partial_x(U^2), is equivalent to the coefficient integral equation stated in E001 for z_k(t)=exp(ik^3t) U^hat(t)(k). Such z is in L^infinity([0,T];dot H^0) when U is mean-zero. Reflection J transports this equation to u_t+u_xxx=(1/2)partial_x(u^2). Hence continuous L^2 solutions lie in the stated source uniqueness class after inverse reflection.

grounds.reason: Supplies the precise source coefficient formulation and uniqueness class.
Uses reflection on the source distributional solution and invokes Fourier-mode testing for uniqueness.
Fixes the Fourier derivative signs and convolution normalization.
The target equation is distributional with quadratic term (1/2)partial_x(u^2).

note.justification: For each k, the convolution sum of U^hat(l)U^hat(k-l) converges absolutely by Cauchy-Schwarz and is the kth coefficient of U^2. This follows first for Fourier polynomials and then from their L^2 convergence, since ||f^2-g^2||_1 <= (||f||_2+||g||_2)||f-g||_2. Thus each nonlinear Fourier coefficient is continuous in time. Fourier testing gives d U^hat(k)/dt=-ik^3 U^hat(k)+(ik/2)sum_l U^hat(l)U^hat(k-l); multiplying by exp(ik^3t) and integrating yields exactly the phase exp(i3k l(k-l)t). Conversely these integrated identities imply the distributional equation, first for finite spatial Fourier tests and then for smooth tests by their Fourier convergence and the L^2/L^1 bounds. A continuous L^2 path is bounded on the compact time interval, and twisting preserves its norm. Reflection is a continuous change of variables on distributions, with the derivative signs computed in S002, so the same identities apply to the limiting solution and to any competing continuous L^2 solution.

arguments.proof:
intro f g
funext k
unfold KdVPlan.mul
have he := (Equiv.neg ℤ).tsum_eq (fun j : ℤ => f j * g (-k-j))
change (∑' j : ℤ, -f (-j) * -g (-(k-j))) = ∑' j : ℤ, f j * g (-k-j)
calc
  _ = ∑' j : ℤ, f (-j) * g (-k-(-j)) := by apply tsum_congr; intro j; congr 1 <;> simp <;> congr 1 <;> omega
  _ = _ := he

card.title: Localize native timeouts before expanding proof search
card.obstacle: A recorded native Lean resource limit prevents a candidate from returning useful proof feedback.
procedure: Read the actual native result and confirm owned-process cleanup. Distinguish wall timeout, heartbeat exhaustion, definitional-equality work and an earlier ordinary error from provider or controller faults.
Preserve the candidate, exact target, declared premises, imports, versions and resource settings before changing its implementation. Do not treat a timeout as a mathematical rejection.

Locate the costly application or tactic using a bounded local fragment or retained diagnostics. Address the earliest ordinary type error before interpreting later resource errors; a very small diagnostic allowance may also reject valid code.

Distinguish proof construction from diagnostic term printing or suggestion verification. If a show_term-style wrapper causes the resource failure, recheck the same tactic without the wrapper. Never treat the failed process as an accepted proof.

For expensive implicit inference, inspect the full declaration type and supply the function, object, exponent, index and coercion types explicitly where needed. Name typed intermediate facts rather than asking unification to reconstruct a nested expression.

For an equality or representation bridge, state the intermediate function and the required equality direction explicitly. Use a small checked change, convert, congrArg or extensionality step and a restricted simp only list instead of broad unfolding.

For broad closure or recursive automation, construct intermediate closure facts from the leaves and compose the specific lemmas explicitly. Do not replace every use of automation without locating its cost.

When individually checked pieces pass but their growing inline combination exhausts resources, retain same-node checked helper declarations with their exact parameter/input context and compose their names. The complete assembly must contain their proof bodies and pass native dependency checks; helper success is not target acceptance.

Recheck the smallest changed application with a finite allowance, then the complete original target with all its original inputs. Retain unsuccessful candidates and diagnostics; a faster fragment alone does not establish complete acceptance.

If the selected branch does not help, revisit the diagnosis rather than blindly repeating it or raising limits. Changes to mathematical boundaries require the normal reviewed source/interface procedure.
card.verification: The repaired complete candidate must pass a fresh native check under the pinned environment with the unchanged target and premises; compare performance only with disclosed comparable settings, and keep mathematical audits separate.
card.positive_example: A native equality-check timeout is addressed by a typed intermediate function and a short checked equality bridge, followed by a complete candidate recheck.
card.negative_example: Delete an equality reversal, replace every tactic or increase every timeout solely because an unrelated candidate once compiled afterward.

evidence.note: Bounded retrospective comparisons of completed implementations motivate this diagnostic procedure; individual edits were not all causally isolated and broader effectiveness is unestablished.

20: * `differentiable_tsum` ensures that a series of differentiable functions is differentiable.

42: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x` on a preconnected open set. If the series converges
43: at a point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the
44: derivatives, then the series converges everywhere on the set. -/
45: theorem summable_of_summable_hasFDerivAt_of_isPreconnected (hu : Summable u) (hs : IsOpen s)
46:     (h's : IsPreconnected s) (hf : ∀ n x, x ∈ s → HasFDerivAt (f n) (f' n x) x)
47:     (hf' : ∀ n x, x ∈ s → ‖f' n x‖ ≤ u n) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ s) (hf0 : Summable (f · x₀))
48:     (hx : x ∈ s) : Summable fun n => f n x := by
49:   haveI := Classical.decEq α
50:   rw [summable_iff_cauchySeq_finset] at hf0 ⊢
51:   have A : UniformCauchySeqOn (fun t : Finset α => fun x => ∑ i ∈ t, f' i x) atTop s :=
52:     (tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum hu hf').uniformCauchySeqOn
53:   refine cauchy_map_of_uniformCauchySeqOn_fderiv (f := fun t x ↦ ∑ i ∈ t, f i x)
54:     hs h's A (fun t y hy => ?_) hx₀ hx hf0
55:   exact HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun i _ => hf i y hy
56: 
57: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x` on a preconnected open set. If the series converges
58: at a point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the
59: derivatives, then the series converges everywhere on the set. -/
60: theorem summable_of_summable_hasDerivAt_of_isPreconnected (hu : Summable u) (ht : IsOpen t)
61:     (h't : IsPreconnected t) (hg : ∀ n y, y ∈ t → HasDerivAt (g n) (g' n y) y)
62:     (hg' : ∀ n y, y ∈ t → ‖g' n y‖ ≤ u n) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ t) (hg0 : Summable (g · y₀))
63:     (hy : y ∈ t) : Summable fun n => g n y := by
64:   simp_rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt] at hg
65:   refine summable_of_summable_hasFDerivAt_of_isPreconnected hu ht h't hg ?_ hy₀ hg0 hy
66:   simpa
67: 
68: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x` on a preconnected open set. If the series converges
69: at a point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the
70: derivatives, then the series is differentiable on the set and its derivative is the sum of the
71: derivatives. -/
72: theorem hasFDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hu : Summable u) (hs : IsOpen s)
73:     (h's : IsPreconnected s) (hf : ∀ n x, x ∈ s → HasFDerivAt (f n) (f' n x) x)
74:     (hf' : ∀ n x, x ∈ s → ‖f' n x‖ ≤ u n) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ s) (hf0 : Summable fun n => f n x₀)
75:     (hx : x ∈ s) : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑' n, f n y) (∑' n, f' n x) x := by
76:   classical
77:     have A :
78:       ∀ x : E, x ∈ s → Tendsto (fun t : Finset α => ∑ n ∈ t, f n x) atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, f n x)) := by
79:       intro y hy
80:       apply Summable.hasSum
81:       exact summable_of_summable_hasFDerivAt_of_isPreconnected hu hs h's hf hf' hx₀ hf0 hy
82:     refine hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn hs (tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum hu hf')
83:       (fun t y hy => ?_) A hx
84:     exact HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun n _ => hf n y hy
85: 
86: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x` on a preconnected open set. If the series converges
87: at a point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the
88: derivatives, then the series is differentiable on the set and its derivative is the sum of the
89: derivatives. -/
90: theorem hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hu : Summable u) (ht : IsOpen t)
91:     (h't : IsPreconnected t) (hg : ∀ n y, y ∈ t → HasDerivAt (g n) (g' n y) y)
92:     (hg' : ∀ n y, y ∈ t → ‖g' n y‖ ≤ u n) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ t) (hg0 : Summable fun n => g n y₀)
93:     (hy : y ∈ t) : HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑' n, g n z) (∑' n, g' n y) y := by
94:   simp_rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt] at hg ⊢
95:   convert! hasFDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu ht h't hg ?_ hy₀ hg0 hy
96:   · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL 𝕜 𝕜 F 1).map_tsum <|
97:       .of_norm_bounded hu fun n ↦ hg' n y hy
98:   · simpa

100: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x`. If the series converges at a
101: point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the derivatives,
102: then the series converges everywhere. -/
103: theorem summable_of_summable_hasFDerivAt (hu : Summable u)
104:     (hf : ∀ n x, HasFDerivAt (f n) (f' n x) x) (hf' : ∀ n x, ‖f' n x‖ ≤ u n)
105:     (hf0 : Summable fun n => f n x₀) (x : E) : Summable fun n => f n x := by
106:   letI : RCLike 𝕜 := IsRCLikeNormedField.rclike 𝕜
107:   let _ : NormedSpace ℝ E := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ 𝕜 _
108:   exact summable_of_summable_hasFDerivAt_of_isPreconnected hu isOpen_univ isPreconnected_univ
109:     (fun n x _ => hf n x) (fun n x _ => hf' n x) (mem_univ _) hf0 (mem_univ _)
110: 
111: /-- Consider a series of functions `∑' n, f n x`. If the series converges at a
112: point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the derivatives,
113: then the series converges everywhere. -/
114: theorem summable_of_summable_hasDerivAt (hu : Summable u)
115:     (hg : ∀ n y, HasDerivAt (g n) (g' n y) y) (hg' : ∀ n y, ‖g' n y‖ ≤ u n)
116:     (hg0 : Summable fun n => g n y₀) (y : 𝕜) : Summable fun n => g n y := by
117:   exact summable_of_summable_hasDerivAt_of_isPreconnected hu isOpen_univ isPreconnected_univ
118:     (fun n x _ => hg n x) (fun n x _ => hg' n x) (mem_univ _) hg0 (mem_univ _)

121: point, and all functions in the series are differentiable with a summable bound on the derivatives,
122: then the series is differentiable and its derivative is the sum of the derivatives. -/
123: theorem hasFDerivAt_tsum (hu : Summable u) (hf : ∀ n x, HasFDerivAt (f n) (f' n x) x)
124:     (hf' : ∀ n x, ‖f' n x‖ ≤ u n) (hf0 : Summable fun n => f n x₀) (x : E) :
125:     HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑' n, f n y) (∑' n, f' n x) x := by
126:   letI : RCLike 𝕜 := IsRCLikeNormedField.rclike 𝕜
127:   let A : NormedSpace ℝ E := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ 𝕜 _
128:   exact hasFDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu isOpen_univ isPreconnected_univ
129:     (fun n x _ => hf n x) (fun n x _ => hf' n x) (mem_univ _) hf0 (mem_univ _)

classical
have hh : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, t ∈ Set.Icc a b → u t = KdVPlan.FromLP s y := by
  intro t

    exact ⟨y,fun _ => hy⟩
  · exact ⟨0,fun ht' => False.elim (ht ht')⟩
choose x hx using hh
refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
apply Metric.continuousOn_iff.mpr
intro t ht ε hε
obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := hu.2 t ht ε hε
refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
intro r hr hrt
have he : u r-u t = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x r-x t) := by
  rw [hx r hr, hx t ht]
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_sub]
have hh := hd r hr (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hrt)
rw [he,h_T013.2.1] at hh
simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hh

6: module
7: 
8: public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Basic
9: public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Constructions
10: public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Module
11: public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.Basic
12: public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Bilinear
13: public import Mathlib.Data.Set.MulAntidiagonal
14: 
15: /-!
16: # Discrete Convolution
17: 
18: Discrete convolution over monoids: `(f ⋆[L] g) x = ∑' (a, b) : mulFiber x, L (f a) (g b)`
19: where `mulFiber x = {(a, b) | a * b = x}`. Additive monoids are also supported.
20: 
21: ## Design
22: 
23: Uses a bilinear map `L : E →ₗ[S] E' →ₗ[S] F` to combine values, following
24: `MeasureTheory.convolution`.
25: 
26: The index monoid `M` can be non-commutative (group algebras R[G] with non-abelian G).
27: 
28: `@[to_additive]` generates multiplicative and additive versions from a single definition.
29: The `mul/add` distinction refers to the index monoid `M`: multiplicative sums over
30: `mulFiber x = {(a,b) | a * b = x}`, additive sums over `addFiber x = {(a,b) | a + b = x}`.
31: 
32: ## Main Definitions
33: 
34: * `mulFiber x`: the fiber of multiplication at `x`, all pairs `(a, b)` with `a * b = x`.
35: * `convolution L f g`: the discrete convolution
36:   `(f ⋆[L] g) x = ∑' ab : mulFiber x, L (f ab.1) (g ab.2)`.
37: * `ConvolutionExistsAt L f g x`: the convolution sum is summable at `x`.
38: * `ConvolutionExists L f g`: the convolution sum is summable at every point.
39: 
40: ## Main Results
41: 
42: * `convolution_indicator_one_left`, `convolution_indicator_one_right`: identity element
43:   (`Set.indicator {1} (fun _ => e)` where `L e` is the identity map)
44: * `ConvolutionExists.distrib_add`, `ConvolutionExists.add_distrib`: distributivity over addition
45: * `ConvolutionExistsAt.smul_convolution`, `ConvolutionExistsAt.convolution_smul`:
46:   scalar multiplication
47: * `convolution_comm`: commutativity for symmetric bilinear maps over commutative monoids
48: 
49: ## Notation
50: 
51: | Notation     | Operation                                       |
52: |--------------|-------------------------------------------------|
53: | `f ⋆[L] g`   | `∑' ab : mulFiber x, L (f ab.1.1) (g ab.1.2)`   |
54: | `f ⋆₊[L] g`  | `∑' ab : addFiber x, L (f ab.1.1) (g ab.1.2)`   |
55: 
56: Precedence design: `f:68` and `g:67` gives right associativity (`f ⋆ g ⋆ h` parses as
57: `f ⋆ (g ⋆ h)`), matching function composition `∘` and `MeasureTheory.convolution`.
58: -/
59: 
60: @[expose] public section
61: 
62: open scoped BigOperators
63: 
64: noncomputable section
65: 
66: namespace DiscreteConvolution
67: 
68: variable {M S E E' E'' F F' G R : Type*}
69: 
70: /-! ### Multiplication Fiber -/
71: 
72: section Fiber
73: 
74: variable [Monoid M]
75: 
76: /-- The fiber of multiplication at `x`: all pairs `(a, b)` with `a * b = x`. -/
77: @[to_additive /-- The fiber of addition at `x`: all pairs `(a, b)` with `a + b = x`. -/]
78: def mulFiber (x : M) : Set (M × M) := Set.mulAntidiagonal Set.univ Set.univ x
79: 
80: @[to_additive (attr := grind =)]
81: lemma mem_mulFiber {x : M} {ab : M × M} : ab ∈ mulFiber x ↔ ab.1 * ab.2 = x := by simp [mulFiber]
82: 
83: @[to_additive]
84: lemma mulFiber_one_mem : (1, 1) ∈ mulFiber (1 : M) := by simp [mulFiber]
85: 
86: end Fiber
87: 
88: /-! ### Convolution Definition and Existence -/
89: 
90: section Definition

unfold KdVPlan.weight
calc

  _ = (2 : ℝ)^s * ((k : ℝ)^2)^s := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)

    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.rpow_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) _)
    have hp : (2 : ℝ)^s ≤ (2 : ℝ)^1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hs1
    norm_num at hp
    linarith

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → k ≠ 0 → KdVPlan.weight s k ≤ 4 * |(k : ℝ)| ^ (2*s)
arguments.proof:
intro s k hs hs1 hk
have hx : 1 ≤ (k : ℝ)^2 := by
  have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk
  nlinarith [sq_abs (k : ℝ)]
rw [@yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
unfold KdVPlan.weight
calc
  (1+(k : ℝ)^2)^s ≤ (2*(k : ℝ)^2)^s := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by linarith) hs
  _ = (2 : ℝ)^s * ((k : ℝ)^2)^s := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
  _ ≤ 4 * ((k : ℝ)^2)^s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (@yui_aux_0024 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s hs1) (Real.rpow_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) _)

  0 < T →
    0 < gamma ∧ gamma ≤ 1 →
      0 < R →
        KdVPlan.EFlow →
          KdVPlan.EDependence →
            KdVPlan.SobolevInfrastructure →

'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

helper.name: yui_aux_0025
helper.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → k ≠ 0 → KdVPlan.weight s k ≤ 4 * |(k : ℝ)| ^ (2*s)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0025 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.MemDot s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f ∧ KdVPlan.hn s f ≤ 2*KdVPlan.dn s f
arguments.proof:
intro s f hs hs1 hf
let d : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else |(k : ℝ)|^(2*s)*‖f k‖^2
have hz : f 0 = 0 := hf.1
have hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 := by intro k; unfold KdVPlan.weight; positivity
have hl : ∀ k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 ≤ 4*d k := by
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k; simp [d,hz]
  · dsimp [d]
    rw [if_neg hk]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (@yui_aux_0025 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s k hs hs1 hk) (sq_nonneg ‖f k‖)
    nlinarith
have hd : Summable d := hf.2
have h4 : Summable (fun k => 4*d k) := hd.mul_left 4
have hmem : KdVPlan.MemH s f := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hp hl h4
refine ⟨hmem,?_⟩
change Real.sqrt (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (∑' k, d k)
calc
  _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑' k, 4*d k) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hmem.tsum_le_tsum hl h4)
  _ = 2*Real.sqrt (∑' k, d k) := by rw [tsum_mul_left,Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]; norm_num

  0 < T →
    0 < gamma ∧ gamma ≤ 1 →
      0 < R →
        KdVPlan.EFlow →
          KdVPlan.EDependence →
            KdVPlan.SobolevInfrastructure →
              ∀ (N : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), (KdVPlan.cutoff N fun k => -f (-k)) = fun k => -KdVPlan.cutoff N f (-k)
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

helper.name: yui_aux_0031
helper.statement: ∀ (N : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.cutoff N (fun k => -f (-k)) = (fun k => -KdVPlan.cutoff N f (-k))
helper.application: @yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (U : KdVPlan.Path), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.SourceApprox s T f U → KdVPlan.SmoothApprox s T (fun k => -f (-k)) (fun t k => -U t (-k))
arguments.proof:
intro s f U hs hs1 hU
obtain ⟨v,hv,hconv⟩ := hU
refine ⟨(fun n t k => -v n t (-k)), ?_, ?_⟩
· intro n
  constructor
  · have he := @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (v n) (hv n).1
    rw [← @yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013] at he
    exact he
  · exact @yui_aux_0027 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 T (v n) (hv n).2
· intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := hconv (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨m,?_⟩
  intro n hn t ht
  obtain ⟨hmem,hbound⟩ := hm n hn t ht
  have hcmp := @yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (v n t-U t) hs hs1 hmem
  have he : (fun k => -v n t (-k)) - (fun k => -U t (-k)) = (fun k => -(v n t-U t) (-k)) := by funext k; simp only [Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
  change KdVPlan.HB s ((fun k => -v n t (-k)) - (fun k => -U t (-k))) ε
  rw [he]
  have hr := @yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (v n t-U t)
  exact ⟨hr.1.mpr hcmp.1, by rw [hr.2]; linarith [hcmp.2]⟩

arguments.statement: ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.Data 0 f → KdVPlan.Data 0 g → KdVPlan.hn 0 f + KdVPlan.hn 0 g ≤ 2*R → ∃ u v : KdVPlan.Path, KdVPlan.Exact 0 T f u ∧ KdVPlan.Exact 0 T g v ∧ KdVPlan.UB 0 0 T (fun t => u t-v t) (K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g)) ∧ KdVPlan.UB 0 0 T (fun t => KdVPlan.Twist u t-KdVPlan.Twist v t) (K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g))

obtain ⟨C,D,hC,hD,hdep⟩ := h_E002 (2*R) 0 (by positivity) (by norm_num) (le_refl 0)
let K := 2*(C*D^T)
have hcp : 0 ≤ C*D^T := mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hD.le _)
refine ⟨K,by dsimp [K]; positivity,?_⟩
intro f g hf hg hball
let jf : KdVPlan.Coeff := fun k => -f (-k)
let jg : KdVPlan.Coeff := fun k => -g (-k)
have hfr := @yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f hf
have hgr := @yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g hg
obtain ⟨U,hU,hu⟩ := @yui_aux_0035 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hf
obtain ⟨V,hV,hv⟩ := @yui_aux_0035 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hg
have hdf := (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f (le_refl 0) hf.1 hf.2.1).2
have hdg := (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g (le_refl 0) hg.1 hg.2.1).2
have hsum : KdVPlan.dn 0 jf + KdVPlan.dn 0 jg ≤ 2*R := by
  dsimp [jf,jg]
  rw [@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013, @yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
  linarith
obtain ⟨htw,hph⟩ := hdep T h_H001 jf jg U V hfr hgr hsum hU hV
have hdiffmem := (@yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f g hf.1 hg.1).1
have hdiffzero : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-g) := by
  change f 0-g 0=0
  have hf0 : f 0=0 := hf.2.1
  have hg0 : g 0=0 := hg.2.1
  rw [hf0,hg0]; ring
have he : jf-jg = (fun k => -(f-g) (-k)) := by funext k; simp only [jf,jg,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
have hd : KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g) := by
  rw [he,@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
  exact (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 (f-g) (le_refl 0) hdiffmem hdiffzero).2
have hb : 2*(C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) ≤ K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g) := by
  dsimp [K]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hcp]
let u : KdVPlan.Path := fun t k => -U t (-k)
let v : KdVPlan.Path := fun t k => -V t (-k)
have hp := @yui_aux_0036 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 T (C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) (fun t => U t-V t) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hph
have ht := @yui_aux_0036 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 T (C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) (fun t => KdVPlan.SourceTwist U t-KdVPlan.SourceTwist V t) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) htw
refine ⟨u,v,hu,hv,?_,?_⟩
· intro t ht'
  have heq : u t-v t = (fun k => -(U t-V t) (-k)) := by funext k; simp only [u,v,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨(hp t ht').1,(hp t ht').2.trans hb⟩
· intro t ht'
  have heq : KdVPlan.Twist u t-KdVPlan.Twist v t = (fun k => -(KdVPlan.SourceTwist U t-KdVPlan.SourceTwist V t) (-k)) := by
    change KdVPlan.S (-t) (fun k => -U t (-k))-KdVPlan.S (-t) (fun k => -V t (-k)) = _
    rw [@yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013, @yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
    simp only [neg_neg]
    funext k
    simp only [KdVPlan.SourceTwist,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨(ht t ht').1,(ht t ht').2.trans hb⟩

have hdiffmem := (@yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f g hf.1 hg.1).1

arguments.proof:
obtain ⟨C,D,hC,hD,hdep⟩ := h_E002 (2*R) 0 (by positivity) (by norm_num) (le_refl 0)
let K := 2*(C*D^T)
have hcp : 0 ≤ C*D^T := mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hD.le _)
refine ⟨K,by dsimp [K]; positivity,?_⟩
intro f g hf hg hball
let jf : KdVPlan.Coeff := fun k => -f (-k)
let jg : KdVPlan.Coeff := fun k => -g (-k)
have hfr := @yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f hf
have hgr := @yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g hg
obtain ⟨U,hU,hu⟩ := @yui_aux_0035 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hf
obtain ⟨V,hV,hv⟩ := @yui_aux_0035 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hg
have hdf := (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f (le_refl 0) hf.1 hf.2.1).2
have hdg := (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g (le_refl 0) hg.1 hg.2.1).2
have hsum : KdVPlan.dn 0 jf + KdVPlan.dn 0 jg ≤ 2*R := by
  dsimp [jf,jg]
  rw [@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013, @yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
  linarith
obtain ⟨htw,hph⟩ := hdep T h_H001 jf jg U V hfr hgr hsum hU hV
have hdiffmem := (@yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f g hf.1 hg.1).1
have hdiffzero : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-g) := by
  change f 0-g 0=0
  have hf0 : f 0=0 := hf.2.1
  have hg0 : g 0=0 := hg.2.1
  rw [hf0,hg0]; ring
have he : jf-jg = (fun k => -(f-g) (-k)) := by funext k; simp only [jf,jg,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
have hd : KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g) := by
  rw [he,@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
  exact (@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 (f-g) (le_refl 0) hdiffmem hdiffzero).2
have hb : 2*(C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) ≤ K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g) := by
  dsimp [K]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hcp]
let u : KdVPlan.Path := fun t k => -U t (-k)
let v : KdVPlan.Path := fun t k => -V t (-k)
have hp := @yui_aux_0036 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 T (C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) (fun t => U t-V t) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) hph
have ht := @yui_aux_0036 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 T (C*D^T*KdVPlan.dn 0 (jf-jg)) (fun t => KdVPlan.SourceTwist U t-KdVPlan.SourceTwist V t) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) htw
refine ⟨u,v,hu,hv,?_,?_⟩
· intro t ht'
  have heq : u t-v t = (fun k => -(U t-V t) (-k)) := by funext k; simp only [u,v,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
  change KdVPlan.HB 0 (u t-v t) (K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g))
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨(hp t ht').1,(hp t ht').2.trans hb⟩
· intro t ht'
  have heq : KdVPlan.Twist u t-KdVPlan.Twist v t = (fun k => -(KdVPlan.SourceTwist U t-KdVPlan.SourceTwist V t) (-k)) := by
    change KdVPlan.S (-t) (fun k => -U t (-k))-KdVPlan.S (-t) (fun k => -V t (-k)) = _
    rw [@yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013, @yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013]
    simp only [neg_neg]
    funext k
    simp only [KdVPlan.SourceTwist,Pi.sub_apply,neg_sub_neg,neg_sub]
  change KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Twist u t-KdVPlan.Twist v t) (K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g))
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨(ht t ht').1,(ht t ht').2.trans hb⟩

13: /-!
14: # Differentiability of sum of functions
15: 
16: We prove some `HasSumUniformlyOn` versions of theorems from
17: `Mathlib.Analysis.NormedSpace.FunctionSeries`.
18: 
19: Alongside this we prove `derivWithin_tsum` which states that the derivative of a series of functions
20: is the sum of the derivatives, under suitable conditions we also prove an `iteratedDerivWithin`
21: version.
22: 
23: -/

35: theorem HasSumUniformlyOn.of_norm_le_summable {f : α → β → F} (hu : Summable u) {s : Set β}
36:     (hfu : ∀ n x, x ∈ s → ‖f n x‖ ≤ u n) : HasSumUniformlyOn f (fun x ↦ ∑' n, f n x) s := by
37:   simp [hasSumUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn, tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum hu hfu]
38: 
39: theorem HasSumUniformlyOn.of_norm_le_summable_eventually {ι : Type*} {f : ι → β → F} {u : ι → ℝ}
40:     (hu : Summable u) {s : Set β} (hfu : ∀ᶠ n in cofinite, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖f n x‖ ≤ u n) :
41:     HasSumUniformlyOn f (fun x ↦ ∑' n, f n x) s := by
42:   simp [hasSumUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn,
43:     tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_of_cofinite_eventually hu hfu]

45: lemma SummableLocallyUniformlyOn.of_locally_bounded_eventually [TopologicalSpace β]
46:     [LocallyCompactSpace β] {f : α → β → F} {s : Set β} (hs : IsOpen s)
47:     (hu : ∀ K ⊆ s, IsCompact K → ∃ u : α → ℝ, Summable u ∧
48:     ∀ᶠ n in cofinite, ∀ k ∈ K, ‖f n k‖ ≤ u n) : SummableLocallyUniformlyOn f s := by
49:   apply HasSumLocallyUniformlyOn.summableLocallyUniformlyOn (g := fun x ↦ ∑' n, f n x)
50:   rw [hasSumLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn,
51:     tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hs]
52:   intro K hK hKc
53:   obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := hu K hK hKc

57:     {f : α → β → F} {s : Set β} (hs : IsOpen s)
58:     (hu : ∀ K ⊆ s, IsCompact K → ∃ u : α → ℝ, Summable u ∧ ∀ n, ∀ k ∈ K, ‖f n k‖ ≤ u n) :
59:     SummableLocallyUniformlyOn f s := by

67: variable {ι 𝕜 F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [IsRCLikeNormedField 𝕜]

70: /-- The `derivWithin` of a sum whose derivative is absolutely and uniformly convergent sum on an
71: open set `s` is the sum of the derivatives of sequence of functions on the open set `s` -/
72: theorem derivWithin_tsum {f : ι → 𝕜 → F} (hs : IsOpen s) {x : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s)
73:     (hf : ∀ y ∈ s, Summable fun n ↦ f n y)
74:     (h : SummableLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n ↦ (derivWithin (fun z ↦ f n z) s)) s)
75:     (hf2 : ∀ n r, r ∈ s → DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (f n) r) :
76:     derivWithin (fun z ↦ ∑' n, f n z) s x = ∑' n, derivWithin (f n) s x := by
77:   apply HasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin ?_ (hs.uniqueDiffWithinAt hx)
78:   apply HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
79:   apply hasDerivAt_of_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn hs _ _ (fun y hy ↦ (hf y hy).hasSum) hx
80:     (f' := fun n : Finset ι ↦ fun a ↦ ∑ i ∈ n, derivWithin (fun z ↦ f i z) s a)
81:   · obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h
82:     apply (hasSumLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.mp hg).congr_right
83:     exact fun _ hb ↦ (hg.tsum_eqOn hb).symm
84:   · filter_upwards with t r hr using HasDerivAt.fun_sum
85:       (fun q hq ↦ ((hf2 q r hr).differentiableWithinAt.hasDerivWithinAt.hasDerivAt)
86:       (hs.mem_nhds hr))
87: 
88: /-- If a sequence of functions `fₙ` is such that `∑ fₙ (z)` is summable for each `z` in an
89: open set `s`, and for each `1 ≤ k ≤ m`, the series of `k`-th iterated derivatives
90: `∑ (iteratedDerivWithin k fₙ s) (z)`
91: is summable locally uniformly on `s`, and each `fₙ` is `m`-times differentiable, then the `m`-th
92: iterated derivative of the sum is the sum of the `m`-th iterated derivatives. -/
93: theorem iteratedDerivWithin_tsum {f : ι → 𝕜 → F} (m : ℕ) (hs : IsOpen s)
94:     {x : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hsum : ∀ t ∈ s, Summable (fun n : ι ↦ f n t))
95:     (h : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → SummableLocallyUniformlyOn
96:       (fun n ↦ (iteratedDerivWithin k (fun z ↦ f n z) s)) s)
97:     (hf2 : ∀ n k r, k ≤ m → r ∈ s →
98:       DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (iteratedDerivWithin k (fun z ↦ f n z) s) r) :
99:     iteratedDerivWithin m (fun z ↦ ∑' n, f n z) s x = ∑' n, iteratedDerivWithin m (f n) s x := by
100:   induction m generalizing x with
101:   | zero => simp
102:   | succ m hm =>
103:     simp_rw [iteratedDerivWithin_succ]
104:     rw [← derivWithin_tsum hs hx _ _ (fun n r hr ↦ hf2 n m r (by lia) hr)]
105:     · exact derivWithin_congr (fun t ht ↦ hm ht (fun k hk1 hkm ↦ h k hk1 (by lia))
106:           (fun k r e hr he ↦ hf2 k r e (by lia) he)) (hm hx (fun k hk1 hkm ↦ h k hk1 (by lia))
107:           (fun k r e hr he ↦ hf2 k r e (by lia) he))
108:     · intro r hr
109:       by_cases hm2 : m = 0
110:       · simp [hm2, hsum r hr]
111:       · exact ((h m (by lia) (by lia)).summable hr).congr (fun _ ↦ by simp)
112:     · exact SummableLocallyUniformlyOn_congr
113:         (fun _ _ ht ↦ by rw [iteratedDerivWithin_succ]) (h (m + 1) (by lia) (by lia))

65: * `OrthogonalFamily.range_linearIsometry`: Given a family `G` of inner product spaces and a family
66:   `V : Π i, G i →ₗᵢ[𝕜] E` of isometric embeddings of the `G i` into `E` with mutually-orthogonal
67:   images, the image of the embedding `OrthogonalFamily.linearIsometry` of the Hilbert sum of `G`
68:   into `E` is the closure of the span of the images of the `G i`.
69: 
70: * `HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply`: Given a Hilbert basis `b` of `E`, the entry `b.repr x i` of
71:   `x`'s representation in `ℓ²(ι, 𝕜)` is the inner product `⟪b i, x⟫`.
72: 
73: * `HilbertBasis.hasSum_repr`: Given a Hilbert basis `b` of `E`, a vector `x` in `E` can be
74:   expressed as the "infinite linear combination" `∑' i, b.repr x i • b i` of the basis vectors
75:   `b i`, with coefficients given by the entries `b.repr x i` of `x`'s representation in `ℓ²(ι, 𝕜)`.
76: 
77: * `exists_hilbertBasis`: A Hilbert space admits a Hilbert basis.

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s f → ∀ k : ℤ, ‖f k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k * KdVPlan.hn s f
arguments.proof:
intro s f hf k
obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (h_T013.1 s f).mp hf
have hw : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k := by unfold KdVPlan.weight; positivity
change ‖(KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ) * x k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k * KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.FromLP s x)
rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hw,h_T013.2.1]
exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) x k) hw

321: /-- Test for convergence of the `p`-series: the real-valued series `∑' n : ℕ, (n ^ p)⁻¹` converges
322: if and only if `1 < p`. -/
323: @[simp]
324: theorem summable_nat_pow_inv {p : ℕ} :
325:     Summable (fun n => ((n : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹ : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by
326:   simp only [← rpow_natCast, summable_nat_rpow_inv, Nat.one_lt_cast]

328: /-- Test for convergence of the `p`-series: the real-valued series `∑' n : ℕ, 1 / n ^ p` converges
329: if and only if `1 < p`. -/
330: theorem summable_one_div_nat_pow {p : ℕ} :
331:     Summable (fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by
332:   simp only [one_div, Real.summable_nat_pow_inv]

334: /-- Summability of the `p`-series over `ℤ`. -/
335: theorem summable_one_div_int_pow {p : ℕ} :
336:     (Summable fun n : ℤ ↦ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) ↔ 1 < p := by
337:   refine ⟨fun h ↦ summable_one_div_nat_pow.mp (h.comp_injective Nat.cast_injective),
338:     fun h ↦ .of_nat_of_neg (summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr h)
339:       (((summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr h).mul_left <| 1 / (-1 : ℝ) ^ p).congr fun n ↦ ?_)⟩
340:   rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, neg_eq_neg_one_mul (n : ℝ), mul_pow, mul_one_div, div_div]

344:   apply Summable.of_nat_of_neg
345:   on_goal 2 => simp_rw [Int.cast_neg, abs_neg]
346:   all_goals
347:     simp_rw [Int.cast_natCast, fun n : ℕ => abs_of_nonneg (n.cast_nonneg : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ))]
348:     rwa [summable_nat_rpow, neg_lt_neg_iff]

arguments.statement: Summable (fun k : ℤ => (1+(k : ℝ)^2)⁻¹)
arguments.proof:
have hs : Summable (fun k : ℤ => if k = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := (hasSum_ite_eq 0 (1 : ℝ)).summable
have hp : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 1/(k : ℝ)^2) := Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1 < (2 : ℕ))
apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => by positivity) (fun k => ?_) (hs.add hp)
by_cases hk : k = 0
· subst k; norm_num
· have hkr : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkp : 0 < (k : ℝ)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkr
  have hh : 1/(1+(k : ℝ)^2) ≤ 1/(k : ℝ)^2 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hkp (by linarith)
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply,if_neg hk,zero_add,one_div] using hh

1169: protected theorem hasSum_single [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp : p ≠ ⊤) (f : lp E p) :
1170:     HasSum (fun i : α => lp.single p i (f i : E i)) f := by
1171:   have hp₀ : 0 < p := zero_lt_one.trans_le Fact.out
1172:   have hp' : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hp₀.ne' hp
1173:   have := lp.hasSum_norm hp' f
1174:   rw [HasSum, Metric.tendsto_nhds] at this ⊢
1175:   intro ε hε
1176:   refine (this _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε p.toReal)).mono ?_
1177:   intro s hs
1178:   rw [← Real.rpow_lt_rpow_iff dist_nonneg (le_of_lt hε) hp']
1179:   rw [dist_comm] at hs
1180:   simp only [dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hs ⊢
1181:   have H : ‖(∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i : E i)) - f‖ ^ p.toReal =
1182:       ‖f‖ ^ p.toReal - ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal := by
1183:     simpa only [coeFn_neg, Pi.neg_apply, lp.single_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_sub_neg,
1184:       norm_neg, _root_.norm_neg] using lp.norm_compl_sum_single hp' (-f) s
1185:   rw [← H] at hs
1186:   have : |‖(∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i : E i)) - f‖ ^ p.toReal| =
1187:       ‖(∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i : E i)) - f‖ ^ p.toReal := by
1188:     simp only [Real.abs_rpow_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_norm]
1189:   exact this ▸ hs

arguments.statement: ∀ a : ℤ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) → Summable a → Summable (fun k => (a k)^2) ∧ Real.sqrt (∑' k, (a k)^2) ≤ ∑' k, a k
arguments.proof:
intro a ha hs
have hA : 0 ≤ ∑' k, a k := tsum_nonneg ha
have hpoint (k : ℤ) : (a k)^2 ≤ (∑' j, a j)*a k := by
  have hk := hs.le_tsum k (fun j _ => ha j)
  nlinarith [ha k]
have hsum : Summable (fun k => (a k)^2) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => sq_nonneg _) hpoint (hs.mul_left _)
refine ⟨hsum,?_⟩
calc
  _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑' k, (∑' j, a j)*a k) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hsum.tsum_le_tsum hpoint (hs.mul_left _))
  _ = ∑' k, a k := by rw [tsum_mul_left,Real.sqrt_mul_self hA]

    exact Real.rpow_neg_one _
  calc

arguments.proof:
intro r a b hr
have hbase : 1+((a+b : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 ≤ 2*((1+(a : ℝ)^2)*(1+(b : ℝ)^2)) := by
  push_cast
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((a : ℝ)-(b : ℝ)),sq_nonneg ((a : ℝ)*(b : ℝ))]
unfold KdVPlan.weight
calc
  _ ≤ (2*((1+(a : ℝ)^2)*(1+(b : ℝ)^2)))^r := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hbase hr
  _ = _ := by rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity),Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]; ring

arguments.statement: ∀ (r : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 ≤ r → Summable (fun k => KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖f k‖) → Summable (fun k => KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖) → ∃ x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ k, x k = (KdVPlan.weight r k : ℂ)*KdVPlan.mul f g k) ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r*(∑' k, KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖f k‖)*(∑' k, KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖)
arguments.proof:
intro r f g hr hf hg
classical
let F : ℤ → ℝ := fun a => KdVPlan.weight r a * ‖f a‖
let G : ℤ → ℝ := fun b => KdVPlan.weight r b * ‖g b‖
have hF (a : ℤ) : 0 ≤ F a := by dsimp [F,KdVPlan.weight]; positivity
have hG (b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ G b := by dsimp [G,KdVPlan.weight]; positivity
have hp : Summable (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => F z.1*G z.2) := hf.mul_of_nonneg hg hF hG
let q : (ℤ × ℤ) → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun z => lp.single 2 (z.1+z.2) ((KdVPlan.weight r (z.1+z.2) : ℂ)*f z.1*g z.2)
have hqbound (z : ℤ × ℤ) : ‖q z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r*(F z.1*G z.2) := by
  change ‖lp.single 2 (z.1+z.2) ((KdVPlan.weight r (z.1+z.2) : ℂ)*f z.1*g z.2)‖ ≤ _
  rw [lp.norm_single (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 2),norm_mul,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r r (z.1+z.2)).1]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ)^r*KdVPlan.weight r z.1*KdVPlan.weight r z.2)*‖f z.1‖*‖g z.2‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r z.1 z.2 hr
    _ = _ := by dsimp [F,G]; ring
have hqn : Summable (fun z => ‖q z‖) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun z => norm_nonneg _) hqbound (hp.mul_left ((2 : ℝ)^r))
have hq : Summable q := hqn.of_norm
refine ⟨∑' z, q z, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro k

arguments.statement: ∀ (r : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), 0 ≤ r → Summable (fun k => KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖f k‖) → Summable (fun k => KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖) → ∃ x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ k, x k = (KdVPlan.weight r k : ℂ)*KdVPlan.mul f g k) ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r*(∑' k, KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖f k‖)*(∑' k, KdVPlan.weight r k * ‖g k‖)
arguments.proof:
intro r f g hr hf hg
classical
let F : ℤ → ℝ := fun a => KdVPlan.weight r a * ‖f a‖
let G : ℤ → ℝ := fun b => KdVPlan.weight r b * ‖g b‖
have hF (a : ℤ) : 0 ≤ F a := by dsimp [F,KdVPlan.weight]; positivity
have hG (b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ G b := by dsimp [G,KdVPlan.weight]; positivity
have hp : Summable (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => F z.1*G z.2) := hf.mul_of_nonneg hg hF hG
let q : (ℤ × ℤ) → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun z => lp.single (E := fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 (z.1+z.2) ((KdVPlan.weight r (z.1+z.2) : ℂ)*f z.1*g z.2)

intro s f g hs hf hg k
have hf2 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 2 s f hs hf).1
have hg0 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 s g (by linarith) hg).1

  have he := (@yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 f (by simpa only [mul_zero,zero_add] using hf2)).1

  simpa [KdVPlan.weight] using (@yui_aux_0042 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 g hg0 j)
apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (hfn.mul_right (KdVPlan.hn 0 g))
intro j
rw [norm_mul]
exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgb (k-j)) (norm_nonneg _)

95:     ‖(f x).mkContinuous (C * ‖x‖) (h x)‖ ≤ max C 0 * ‖x‖ :=

101: /-- Create a bilinear map (represented as a map `E →L[𝕜] F →L[𝕜] G`) from the corresponding linear
102: map and existence of a bound on the norm of the image. The linear map can be constructed using
103: `LinearMap.mk₂`.
104: 
105: If you have an explicit bound, use `LinearMap.mkContinuous₂` instead, as a norm estimate will
106: follow automatically in `LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le`. -/
107: def mkContinuousOfExistsBound₂ (f : E →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] F →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] G)
108:     (h : ∃ C, ∀ x y, ‖f x y‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) : E →SL[σ₁₃] F →SL[σ₂₃] G :=
109:   LinearMap.mkContinuousOfExistsBound
110:     { toFun := fun x => (f x).mkContinuousOfExistsBound <| let ⟨C, hC⟩ := h; ⟨C * ‖x‖, hC x⟩
111:       map_add' := fun x y => by
112:         ext z
113:         simp
114:       map_smul' := fun c x => by
115:         ext z
116:         simp } <|
117:     let ⟨C, hC⟩ := h; ⟨max C 0, norm_mkContinuous₂_aux f C hC⟩

119: /-- Create a bilinear map (represented as a map `E →L[𝕜] F →L[𝕜] G`) from the corresponding linear
120: map and a bound on the norm of the image. The linear map can be constructed using
121: `LinearMap.mk₂`. Lemmas `LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le'` and `LinearMap.mkContinuous₂_norm_le`
122: provide estimates on the norm of an operator constructed using this function. -/
123: def mkContinuous₂ (f : E →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] F →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] G) (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ x y, ‖f x y‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) :
124:     E →SL[σ₁₃] F →SL[σ₂₃] G :=
125:   mkContinuousOfExistsBound₂ f ⟨C, hC⟩

129:     (hC : ∀ x y, ‖f x y‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) (x : E) (y : F) : f.mkContinuous₂ C hC x y = f x y :=
130:   rfl

132: theorem mkContinuous₂_norm_le' (f : E →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] F →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] G) {C : ℝ}
133:     (hC : ∀ x y, ‖f x y‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) : ‖f.mkContinuous₂ C hC‖ ≤ max C 0 :=
134:   mkContinuous_norm_le _ (le_max_iff.2 <| Or.inr le_rfl) (norm_mkContinuous₂_aux f C hC)

137:     (hC : ∀ x y, ‖f x y‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) : ‖f.mkContinuous₂ C hC‖ ≤ C :=
138:   (f.mkContinuous₂_norm_le' hC).trans_eq <| max_eq_left h0

arguments.proof:
intro s x y c
constructor
· funext k; simp [KdVPlan.FromLP,mul_add]

arguments.statement: ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → ∃ B : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ∀ x y, KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.FromLP (2*r+2) x) (KdVPlan.FromLP (2*r+2) y) = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*r) (B x y)
arguments.proof:
intro r hr
classical
let p := 2*r+2
let q := 2*r
have hp : 2 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
have hmem (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.MemH p (KdVPlan.FromLP p x) := (h_T013.1 p _).mpr ⟨x,rfl⟩
obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := @yui_aux_0053 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r hr
have hex : ∀ x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ∃ z : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.FromLP p x) (KdVPlan.FromLP p y) = KdVPlan.FromLP q z := by
  intro x y
  exact (h_T013.1 q _).mp (hbound _ _ (hmem x) (hmem y)).1
choose b hb using hex
have hadd (s : ℝ) (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.FromLP s (x+y) = KdVPlan.FromLP s x+KdVPlan.FromLP s y := (@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s x y 0).1
have hsmul (s : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.FromLP s (c • x) = c • KdVPlan.FromLP s x := (@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s x x c).2
have hbil (x x' y y' : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := @yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 p (KdVPlan.FromLP p x) (KdVPlan.FromLP p x') (KdVPlan.FromLP p y) (KdVPlan.FromLP p y') hp (hmem x) (hmem x') (hmem y) (hmem y')
have ha1 (x x' y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : b (x+x') y = b x y+b x' y := by
  apply @yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 q
  rw [hadd,← hb,← hb,← hb,hadd]
  exact (hbil x x' y y).1
have hs1 (c : ℂ) (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : b (c • x) y = c • b x y := by
  apply @yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 q
  rw [hsmul,← hb,← hb,hsmul]
  exact ((hbil x x y y).2.2 c).1
have ha2 (x y y' : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : b x (y+y') = b x y+b x y' := by
  apply @yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 q
  rw [hadd,← hb,← hb,← hb,hadd]
  exact (hbil x x y y').2.1
have hs2 (c : ℂ) (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : b x (c • y) = c • b x y := by
  apply @yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 q
  rw [hsmul,← hb,← hb,hsmul]
  exact ((hbil x x y y).2.2 c).2
have hn (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ‖b x y‖ ≤ C*‖x‖*‖y‖ := by
  have he := (hbound _ _ (hmem x) (hmem y)).2
  change KdVPlan.hn q (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.FromLP p x) (KdVPlan.FromLP p y)) ≤ C*KdVPlan.hn p (KdVPlan.FromLP p x)*KdVPlan.hn p (KdVPlan.FromLP p y) at he
  rw [hb,h_T013.2.1,h_T013.2.1,h_T013.2.1] at he
  exact he
let L : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →ₗ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →ₗ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := LinearMap.mk₂ ℂ b ha1 hs1 ha2 hs2
refine ⟨L.mkContinuous₂ C hn,?_⟩
intro x y
exact hb x y

arguments.statement: ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → (∀ k, ‖c k‖ ≤ C) → ∃ L : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ∀ x k, L x k = c k*x k
arguments.proof:
intro c C hC hc
classical
let z (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨(fun k => c k*x k), by
  apply ((lp.memℓp x).const_smul (C : ℂ)).mono'
  intro k
  change ‖c k*x k‖ ≤ ‖(C : ℂ)*x k‖
  rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hC]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc k) (norm_nonneg _)⟩
let L : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →ₗ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
  { toFun := z
    map_add' := by intro x y; apply Subtype.ext; funext k; change c k*(x k+y k)=c k*x k+c k*y k; ring
    map_smul' := by intro a x; apply Subtype.ext; funext k; change c k*(a*x k)=a*(c k*x k); ring }
have hn (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ‖L x‖ ≤ C*‖x‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(C : ℂ) • x‖ := lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) (fun k => by
      change ‖c k*x k‖ ≤ ‖(C : ℂ)*x k‖
      rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hC]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc k) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ = C*‖x‖ := by rw [norm_smul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hC]
exact ⟨L.mkContinuous C hn, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

32: differentiable there, and its derivative (formulated with `derivWithin`) is `C^n`. -/

34:     ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔
35:       DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ (n = ω → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f s) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n (derivWithin f s) s := by

arguments.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (k : ℤ), ‖(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^d * (KdVPlan.weight (-(d : ℝ)) k : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
arguments.proof:
intro d k
have hb : 0 < 1+(k : ℝ)^2 := by positivity
have hk : |(k : ℝ)| ≤ 1+(k : ℝ)^2 := by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|(k : ℝ)|-1),sq_abs (k : ℝ)]
have hw : KdVPlan.weight (-(d : ℝ)) k = ((1+(k : ℝ)^2)^d)⁻¹ := by
  unfold KdVPlan.weight
  rw [Real.rpow_neg hb.le,Real.rpow_natCast]
have hwp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-(d : ℝ)) k := (@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 (-(d : ℝ)) 0 k).1.le
rw [norm_mul,norm_pow,norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,one_mul,Complex.norm_intCast,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hwp,hw]
exact (mul_inv_le_one₀ (pow_pos hb d)).mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hk d)

arguments.statement: ∀ u : KdVPlan.Path, KdVPlan.ContH 2 0 T u → ∀ k : ℤ, ContinuousOn (fun t => KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k) (Set.Icc 0 T)
arguments.proof:
intro u hu k
obtain ⟨x,hx,hc⟩ := @yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 2 0 T u hu
obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 (le_refl 0)
have hB' (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.FromLP 2 x) (KdVPlan.FromLP 2 y) = KdVPlan.FromLP 0 (B x y) := by simpa only [mul_zero,zero_add] using hB x y
have hbc : ContinuousOn (fun t => B (x t) (x t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (B.continuous.comp_continuousOn hc).clm_apply hc
have hec : ContinuousOn (fun t => B (x t) (x t) k) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (lp.lipschitzWith_one_eval 2 k).continuous.comp_continuousOn hbc
apply hec.congr
intro t ht
change KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k = B (x t) (x t) k
rw [hx t ht,hB']
simp [KdVPlan.FromLP,KdVPlan.weight]

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.KSol s T f u → KdVPlan.ContH 2 0 T u → ∀ (k : ℤ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T → HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.Twist u r k) ((1/2 : ℂ)*KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Twist u t) (KdVPlan.Twist u t) k) t

intro s f u hu h2 k t ht
have hinv (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) = u r := by
  change KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.S (-r) (u r)) = u r
  rw [(@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r (-r) (u r)).1,add_neg_cancel]
  exact (@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 (u r)).2
have hbeq (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) (KdVPlan.Twist u r) k = Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-r)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u r) (u r) k := by
  unfold KdVPlan.B
  rw [hinv]
  rfl
have hc : ContinuousOn (fun r => KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) (KdVPlan.Twist u r) k) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
  simp_rw [hbeq]
  have hp : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-r)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))) := by fun_prop
  exact (hp.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const).mul (@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 u h2 k)
have htc : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht
have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
  ((hc.mono (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨le_rfl,h_H001.le⟩ htc)).intervalIntegrable)
  (ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo (hc.mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self) t ht)
  ((hc t htc).continuousAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
have he : (fun r => KdVPlan.Twist u r k) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun r => f k+(1/2 : ℂ)*∫ a in (0 : ℝ)..r, KdVPlan.B a (KdVPlan.Twist u a) (KdVPlan.Twist u a) k) := by
  filter_upwards [Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with r hr
  exact congrFun (hu.2.2.2 r hr) k
exact ((hi.const_mul (1/2 : ℂ)).const_add (f k)).congr_of_eventuallyEq he

arguments.proof:
intro s f u hu h2 k t ht
have hinv (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) = u r := by
  change KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.S (-r) (u r)) = u r
  rw [(@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r (-r) (u r)).1,add_neg_cancel]
  exact (@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 (u r)).2
have hbeq (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) (KdVPlan.Twist u r) k = Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-r)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u r) (u r) k := by
  unfold KdVPlan.B
  rw [hinv]
  simp only [KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.dx,mul_assoc]
have hc : ContinuousOn (fun r => KdVPlan.B r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) (KdVPlan.Twist u r) k) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
  simp_rw [hbeq]
  have hp : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-r)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))) := by fun_prop
  exact (hp.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const).mul (@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 u h2 k)
have htc : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht
have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
  ((hc.mono (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨le_rfl,h_H001.le⟩ htc)).intervalIntegrable)
  (ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo (hc.mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self) t ht)
  ((hc t htc).continuousAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2))
have he : (fun r => KdVPlan.Twist u r k) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun r => f k+(1/2 : ℂ)*∫ a in (0 : ℝ)..r, KdVPlan.B a (KdVPlan.Twist u a) (KdVPlan.Twist u a) k) := by
  filter_upwards [Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with r hr
  exact congrFun (hu.2.2.2 r hr) k
exact ((hi.const_mul (1/2 : ℂ)).const_add (f k)).congr_of_eventuallyEq he

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (u : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.KSol s T f u → KdVPlan.ContH 2 0 T u → ∀ (k : ℤ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T → HasDerivAt (fun r => u r k) (-(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k+(1/2 : ℂ)*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k) t
arguments.proof:
intro s f u hu h2 k t ht
let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun r => Complex.exp (Complex.I*(r*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))
let em : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-t)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))
have hinv (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) = u r := by
  change KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.S (-r) (u r)) = u r
  rw [(@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r (-r) (u r)).1,add_neg_cancel]
  exact (@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 (u r)).2
have hfun : (fun r => e r*KdVPlan.Twist u r k) = (fun r => u r k) := funext (fun r => congrFun (hinv r) k)
have hval : e t*KdVPlan.Twist u t k = u t k := congrFun hfun t
have hphase : e t*em = 1 := by
  dsimp [e,em]
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  convert Complex.exp_zero using 1
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring
have hb : KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Twist u t) (KdVPlan.Twist u t) k = em*((Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k) := by
  unfold KdVPlan.B
  rw [hinv]
  rfl
have he := @yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 k t
have hv := @yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s f u hu h2 k t ht
have hd := he.mul hv
change HasDerivAt (fun r => e r*KdVPlan.Twist u r k) ((e t*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ)^3))*KdVPlan.Twist u t k+e t*((1/2 : ℂ)*KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Twist u t) (KdVPlan.Twist u t) k)) t at hd
rw [hfun] at hd
apply hd.congr_deriv
rw [hb]
have hI : Complex.I^3 = -Complex.I := by calc _ = Complex.I^2*Complex.I := by ring; _ = _ := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
calc
  _ = (Complex.I*(k : ℂ)^3)*(e t*KdVPlan.Twist u t k)+(1/2 : ℂ)*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k*(e t*em) := by ring
  _ = _ := by rw [hval,hphase,mul_pow,hI]; ring

let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun r => Complex.exp (Complex.I*(r*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))
let em : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I*((-t)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ))
have hinv (r : ℝ) : KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.Twist u r) = u r := by
  change KdVPlan.S r (KdVPlan.S (-r) (u r)) = u r
  rw [(@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 r (-r) (u r)).1,add_neg_cancel]
  exact (@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 0 0 (u r)).2
have hfun : (fun r => e r*KdVPlan.Twist u r k) = (fun r => u r k) := funext (fun r => congrFun (hinv r) k)
have hval : e t*KdVPlan.Twist u t k = u t k := congrFun hfun t
have hphase : e t*em = 1 := by
  dsimp [e,em]
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  convert Complex.exp_zero using 1

  push_cast

  unfold KdVPlan.B
  rw [hinv]

have he := @yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 k t
have hv := @yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s f u hu h2 k t ht
have hd := he.mul hv
change HasDerivAt (fun r => e r*KdVPlan.Twist u r k) ((e t*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ)^3))*KdVPlan.Twist u t k+e t*((1/2 : ℂ)*KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.Twist u t) (KdVPlan.Twist u t) k)) t at hd
rw [hfun] at hd
apply hd.congr_deriv
rw [hb]

arguments.statement: ∀ x y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ContinuousOn x (Set.Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc 0 T) → (∀ (k : ℤ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T → HasDerivAt (fun r => x r k) (y t k) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt x (y t) (Set.Icc 0 T) t
arguments.proof:
intro x y hx hy hd
have heq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, x t = x 0+∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r := by
  intro t ht
  have hsub : Set.Icc 0 t ⊆ Set.Icc 0 T := fun r hr => ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable y volume 0 t := (hy.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.1
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext k
  let ev : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℝ] ℂ := (lp.evalCLM ℂ (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 k).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hxc : ContinuousOn (fun r => x r k) (Set.Icc 0 t) := ev.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hx.mono hsub)
  have hyc : ContinuousOn (fun r => y r k) (Set.Icc 0 t) := ev.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hy.mono hsub)
  have hs : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r k) = x t k-x 0 k := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le ht.1 hxc (fun r hr => hd k r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩) (hyc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.1)
  have hev := ev.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  change x t k = x 0 k+ev (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r)
  rw [← hev]
  change x t k = x 0 k+∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r k
  rw [hs]
  abel
intro t ht
haveI : Fact (t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) := ⟨ht⟩
have hi : IntervalIntegrable y volume 0 t := (hy.mono (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨le_rfl,h_H001.le⟩ ht)).intervalIntegrable
have hD := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivWithinAt_right hi (hy.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter_nhdsWithin measurableSet_Icc t) (hy t ht)
exact (hD.const_add (x 0)).congr heq (heq t ht)

result.proof:
intro x y hx hy hd
have heq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, x t = x 0+∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r := by
  intro t ht
  have hsub : Set.Icc 0 t ⊆ Set.Icc 0 T := fun r hr => ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable y volume 0 t := (hy.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.1
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext k
  let ev : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℝ] ℂ := (lp.evalCLM ℂ (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 k).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hxc : ContinuousOn (fun r => x r k) (Set.Icc 0 t) := ev.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hx.mono hsub)
  have hyc : ContinuousOn (fun r => y r k) (Set.Icc 0 t) := ev.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hy.mono hsub)
  have hs : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r k) = x t k-x 0 k := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le ht.1 hxc (fun r hr => hd k r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩) (hyc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.1)
  have hev := ev.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  change x t k = x 0 k+ev (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r)
  rw [← hev]
  change x t k = x 0 k+∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, y r k
  rw [hs]
  abel
intro t ht
haveI : Fact (t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) := ⟨ht⟩
have hi : IntervalIntegrable y volume 0 t := (hy.mono (Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨le_rfl,h_H001.le⟩ ht)).intervalIntegrable
have hD := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivWithinAt_right hi (hy.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter_nhdsWithin measurableSet_Icc t) (hy t ht)
exact (hD.const_add (x 0)).congr heq (heq t ht)

helper.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2), f = KdVPlan.FromLP s x → ∀ k, x k = (KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ)*f k
helper.application: @yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (u d : KdVPlan.Path) (x y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2), ContinuousOn x (Set.Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc 0 T) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u t = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x t)) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, d t = KdVPlan.FromLP s (y t)) → (∀ (k : ℤ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T → HasDerivAt (fun r => u r k) (d t k) t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt x (y t) (Set.Icc 0 T) t
arguments.proof:
intro s u d x y hx hy hxu hyd hd
apply @yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 x y hx hy
intro k t ht
have hinvx (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) := @yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (u r) (x r) (hxu r hr) k
have he : (fun r => x r k) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun r => (KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ)*u r k) := by
  filter_upwards [Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with r hr
  exact hinvx r hr
have hder := ((hd k t ht).const_mul (KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq he
apply hder.congr_deriv
exact (@yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (d t) (y t) (hyd t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)) k).symm

arguments.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ x : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u t = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*(m : ℝ)) (x t)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ n x (Set.Icc 0 T)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (fun k : ℤ => -(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k+(1/2 : ℂ)*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k) = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*(m : ℝ)) (y t)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ n y (Set.Icc 0 T)

intro n u hu m
let s : ℝ := 2*(m : ℝ)
obtain ⟨x3,hx3,hc3⟩ := hu (m+3)
obtain ⟨x2,hx2,hc2⟩ := hu (m+2)
have h3 : 2*((m+3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+2*(3 : ℝ) := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
have h2 : 2*((m+2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
simp only [h3] at hx3
simp only [h2] at hx2
obtain ⟨L3,hL3⟩ := @yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s 3
obtain ⟨L1,hL1⟩ := @yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s 1
obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 ((m : ℝ)+1) (by positivity)
have hp : 2*((m : ℝ)+1)+2 = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; ring
have hq : 2*((m : ℝ)+1) = s+2 := by dsimp [s]; ring
simp only [hp,hq] at hB
let y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun t => -L3 (x3 t)+(1/2 : ℂ) • L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hcB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => B (x2 t) (x2 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
  exact (((B.bilinearRestrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc2).clm_apply hc2)
have hcL3 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L3 (x3 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L3.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc3
have hcL1 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L1.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcB
refine ⟨y,?_,hcL3.neg.add (hcL1.const_smul (1/2 : ℂ))⟩
intro t ht
have hlin : (fun k : ℤ => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L3 (x3 t)) := by rw [hx3 t ht]; exact hL3 (x3 t)
have hnon : KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t)) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) := by
  rw [hx2 t ht,hB]
  simpa only [mul_one,pow_one] using hL1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hneg (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.FromLP s (-x) = -KdVPlan.FromLP s x := by

have hp : 2*((m : ℝ)+1)+2 = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; ring

intro n u hu m
let s : ℝ := 2*(m : ℝ)
obtain ⟨x3,hx3,hc3⟩ := hu (m+3)
obtain ⟨x2,hx2,hc2⟩ := hu (m+2)
have h3 : 2*((m+3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+2*(3 : ℝ) := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
have h2 : 2*((m+2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
simp only [h3] at hx3
simp only [h2] at hx2
obtain ⟨L3,hL3⟩ := @yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s 3
obtain ⟨L1,hL1⟩ := @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s
obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 ((m : ℝ)+1) (by positivity)
have hp : 2*((m : ℝ)+1)+2 = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; ring
have hq : 2*((m : ℝ)+1) = s+2 := by dsimp [s]; ring
simp only [hp] at hB
simp only [hq] at hB
let y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun t => -L3 (x3 t)+(1/2 : ℂ) • L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hcB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => B (x2 t) (x2 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
  exact (((B.bilinearRestrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc2).clm_apply hc2)
have hcL3 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L3 (x3 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L3.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc3
have hcL1 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L1.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcB
refine ⟨y,?_,hcL3.neg.add (hcL1.const_smul (1/2 : ℂ))⟩
intro t ht
have hlin : (fun k : ℤ => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L3 (x3 t)) := by rw [hx3 t ht]; exact hL3 (x3 t)
have hnon : KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t)) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) := by

  exact hL1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hneg (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.FromLP s (-x) = -KdVPlan.FromLP s x := by
  simpa only [neg_one_smul] using (@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s x x (-1)).2
change _ = KdVPlan.FromLP s (-L3 (x3 t)+(1/2 : ℂ) • L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t)))

helper.name: yui_aux_0073
helper.statement: ∀ s : ℝ, ∃ L : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ∀ x, KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.FromLP (s+2) x) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L x)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : KdVPlan.Path), (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ x : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u t = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*(m : ℝ)) (x t)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ n x (Set.Icc 0 T)) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (fun k : ℤ => -(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k+(1/2 : ℂ)*(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))*KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t) k) = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*(m : ℝ)) (y t)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ n y (Set.Icc 0 T)
arguments.proof:
intro n u hu m
let s : ℝ := 2*(m : ℝ)
obtain ⟨x3,hx3,hc3⟩ := hu (m+3)
obtain ⟨x2,hx2,hc2⟩ := hu (m+2)
have h3 : 2*((m+3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+2*(3 : ℝ) := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
have h2 : 2*((m+2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; push_cast; ring
simp only [h3] at hx3
simp only [h2] at hx2
obtain ⟨L3,hL3⟩ := @yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s 3
obtain ⟨L1,hL1⟩ := @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s
obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 ((m : ℝ)+1) (by positivity)
have hp : 2*((m : ℝ)+1)+2 = s+4 := by dsimp [s]; ring
have hq : 2*((m : ℝ)+1) = s+2 := by dsimp [s]; ring
simp only [hp] at hB
simp only [hq] at hB
let y : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun t => -L3 (x3 t)+(1/2 : ℂ) • L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hcB : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => B (x2 t) (x2 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
  exact (((B.bilinearRestrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc2).clm_apply hc2)
have hcL3 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L3 (x3 t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L3.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hc3
have hcL1 : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) (Set.Icc 0 T) := (L1.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcB
refine ⟨y,?_,hcL3.neg.add (hcL1.const_smul (1/2 : ℂ))⟩
intro t ht
have hlin : (fun k : ℤ => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))^3*u t k) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L3 (x3 t)) := by rw [hx3 t ht]; exact hL3 (x3 t)
have hnon : KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul (u t) (u t)) = KdVPlan.FromLP s (L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))) := by
  rw [hx2 t ht,hB]
  exact hL1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t))
have hneg (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : KdVPlan.FromLP s (-x) = -KdVPlan.FromLP s x := by
  simpa only [neg_one_smul] using (@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s x x (-1)).2
change _ = KdVPlan.FromLP s (-L3 (x3 t)+(1/2 : ℂ) • L1 (B (x2 t) (x2 t)))
rw [(@yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s _ _ 0).1,hneg,(@yui_aux_0072 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (1/2) _),← hlin,← hnon]
funext k
simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.neg_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,KdVPlan.dx]
ring

134: /-- To check that a function is `n` times continuously differentiable, it suffices to check that its
135: first `n` derivatives are differentiable. This is slightly too strong as the condition we
136: require on the `n`-th derivative is differentiability instead of continuity, but it has the
137: advantage of avoiding the discussion of continuity in the proof (and for `n = ∞` this is optimal).
138: -/
139: theorem contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn_deriv {n : ℕ∞}
140:     (h : ∀ m : ℕ, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ n → DifferentiableOn 𝕜 (iteratedDerivWithin m f s) s) :
141:     ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f s := by
142:   apply contDiffOn_of_differentiableOn
143:   simpa only [iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_equiv_comp, LinearIsometryEquiv.comp_differentiableOn_iff]
144: 
145: /-- On a set with unique derivatives, a `C^n` function has derivatives up to `n` which are
146: continuous. -/
147: theorem ContDiffOn.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin
148:     {n : ℕ∞ω} {m : ℕ} (h : ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f s)
149:     (hmn : m ≤ n) (hs : UniqueDiffOn 𝕜 s) : ContinuousOn (iteratedDerivWithin m f s) s := by

151:     h.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hmn hs

  have heq (k : ℤ) : Set.EqOn (fun t => u t k) (fun t => L k (x t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun t ht => congrFun (hx t ht) k
  constructor
  · intro k

  · intro j
    have hj : (j : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast (le_top : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
    have hcj := hcx.continuousOn_iteratedDerivWithin hj (uniqueDiffOn_Icc h_H001)
    have hcjH := @yui_aux_0076 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (iteratedDerivWithin j x (Set.Icc 0 T)) hcj
    apply @yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s 0 T _ _ _ hcjH
    intro t ht
    funext k
    calc
      _ = iteratedDerivWithin j (fun r => L k (x r)) (Set.Icc 0 T) t := iteratedDerivWithin_congr (heq k) ht
      _ = L k (iteratedDerivWithin j x (Set.Icc 0 T) t) := @yui_aux_0077 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 x hcx (L k) j t ht

  have heq (k : ℤ) : Set.EqOn (fun t => u t k) (fun t => L k (x t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun t ht => congrFun (hx t ht) k

    intro t ht
    funext k
    calc
      _ = iteratedDerivWithin j (fun r => L k (x r)) (Set.Icc 0 T) t := iteratedDerivWithin_congr (heq k) ht

arguments.statement: ∀ u : KdVPlan.Path, (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ x : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u t = KdVPlan.FromLP (2*(m : ℝ)) (x t)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) x (Set.Icc 0 T)) → KdVPlan.SmoothOn 0 T u
arguments.proof:
intro u hu
have hlevel (m : ℕ) : (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t => u t k) (Set.Icc 0 T)) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, KdVPlan.ContH (2*(m : ℝ)) 0 T (fun t k => iteratedDerivWithin j (fun r => u r k) (Set.Icc 0 T) t) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hcx⟩ := hu m
  let s : ℝ := 2*(m : ℝ)
  let L (k : ℤ) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℝ] ℂ := (KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ) • (lp.evalCLM ℂ (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 k).restrictScalars ℝ
  have heq (k : ℤ) : Set.EqOn (fun t => u t k) (fun t => L k (x t)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := fun t ht => congrFun (hx t ht) k
  constructor
  · intro k
    exact ((L k).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hcx).congr (heq k)
  · intro j

arguments.statement: ∀ D : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, (∀ t x, ‖D t x‖ = ‖x‖) → (∀ x, Continuous (fun t => D t x)) → ∀ x : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ContinuousOn x (Set.Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn (fun t => D t (x t)) (Set.Icc 0 T)
arguments.proof:
intro D hnorm hfix x hx t ht
have hfirst : Tendsto (fun r => ‖x r-x t‖) (nhdsWithin t (Set.Icc 0 T)) (nhds 0) := tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mp (hx t ht)
have hsecond : Tendsto (fun r => ‖D r (x t)-D t (x t)‖) (nhdsWithin t (Set.Icc 0 T)) (nhds 0) := (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mp ((hfix (x t)).continuousAt)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
have hsum := hfirst.add hsecond
simp only [add_zero] at hsum
have hle (r : ℝ) : ‖D r (x r)-D t (x t)‖ ≤ ‖x r-x t‖+‖D r (x t)-D t (x t)‖ := by
  calc
    _ = ‖D r (x r-x t)+(D r (x t)-D t (x t))‖ := by congr 1; rw [map_sub]; abel
    _ ≤ ‖D r (x r-x t)‖+‖D r (x t)-D t (x t)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hnorm]
apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
exact squeeze_zero (fun r => norm_nonneg _) hle hsum
